Starting as a Java developer in 2018, I gradually shifted toward building scalable systems using Go and Python. Over time, I’ve focused on creating seamless user experiences, which led me to React and TypeScript. My work now centers on eco-conscious e-commerce platforms, where I design REST APIs and microservices that balance performance with sustainability goals.  

At EcoCart Solutions, I’m driven by the challenge of turning complex technical problems into intuitive solutions. Whether optimizing backend workflows or refining frontend interactions, I aim to make digital experiences both efficient and accessible. My recent projects involved refactoring legacy systems with Python, which improved deployment times by 40%, and implementing React components that boosted user engagement metrics.  

I thrive in environments where code meets impact. My toolkit includes AWS for cloud infrastructure, TypeScript for maintainable code, and a knack for simplifying distributed systems. When I’m not writing clean code, you’ll find me experimenting with new tools or sharing insights on tech trends.  

Let’s connect if you’re building something that matters—whether it’s scalable systems, sustainable solutions, or just great code. I’m always curious about how to solve problems better.
